_설명: 잠긴 문항 5편(2026-11-14). 판매가 목적이라 「한 가지는 쓸모 있게 들려주고, 남은 것을 이름 붙여 잠근다」. cues 에 없는 자막은 소리로도 그림으로도 내지 않는다. label 은 /honjoo100 목록에 보이는 번호(slug 와 다를 수 있다 — p6-07 은 P6·06).

p2-04.label: P2·04
p2-04.hook:
상담 가기 전,
이 세 가지 챙기세요
p2-04.title: 혼주 사전 상담 전, 준비물 세 가지
p2-04.loop_voice: 둘째와 셋째 준비물, 특히 정수리 고민이 있다면 꼭 들어 보세요.

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride walking into a calm, bright makeup consultation studio, holding a slim folder under her arm, NOT a wedding hall.
scenes.m: She walks slowly away from the camera toward a small table; her skirt sways gently; she never turns.

scenes.img: Still life: three small blank cream cards laid in a neat row on a wooden consultation table beside a closed makeup case, soft daylight, no writing.
Still life: a smartphone lying on a table showing a photo of a folded pale pink silk jeogori and deep magenta chima, beside a coffee cup, soft light.
Close still life: a swatch of pale pink silk jeogori fabric laid next to an open makeup palette of soft rose and coral tones on a white counter.
scenes.m: Soft daylight slowly moves across the silk, making a gentle sheen glide over the fabric; nothing else moves.

p2-06.label: P2·06
p2-06.title: 원하는 사진 들고 가도 될까? 혼주 상담 팁
p2-06.loop_voice: 연예인 사진이라도 괜찮을까요? 나와 얼굴형이 달라도요?

scenes.img: Close back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated at a consultation table, holding a smartphone in one hand, NOT a wedding hall.
scenes.m: She slowly lowers the phone toward the table; one action only, five natural fingers; she never turns.

scenes.img: Still life: a smartphone face-up on a table with its screen softly glowing blank, next to small hanbok fabric swatches in pink and magenta.
Still life: several small printed photos of elegant low chignon updos seen only from behind, spread on a table, no faces anywhere.
Close back view of the same woman in a makeup chair; a makeup artist's hand holds a brush paused in the air beside her, a moment of hesitation, NOT a wedding hall.
Still life: two blush compacts side by side on a white counter, one barely-there sheer pink, one vivid rose.
scenes.m: An extremely slow push-in between the two compacts; soft light shifts; nothing else moves.

scenes.img: Close view from behind the same woman's shoulder: her hand places one printed photo of an elegant updo seen from behind onto the table.
scenes.m: Her hand slowly sets the photo down and rests beside it; one action only, five natural fingers.

p6-07.label: P6·06
p6-07.hook:
식장에서 눈물,
손으로 닦으면 안 돼요
p6-07.title: 예식 중 눈물, 손으로 닦으면 생기는 일
p6-07.loop_voice: 번지지 않게 닦는 법, 그리고 번졌을 때 바로 고치는 법까지 있어요.

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated in the front row of a bright wedding hall, white flowers and candles ahead, her shoulders slightly raised with emotion.
scenes.m: Candle flames flicker softly; her shoulders rise and fall once with a quiet breath; she never turns.

scenes.img: Back view of the same woman from far behind, the couple bowing in the distance at the end of the aisle, soft light, everything small and blurred ahead.
scenes.m: Very slow push-in toward her back; petals drift down slowly; she never turns.

scenes.img: Still life on a vanity: an open waterproof mascara tube lying beside a white tissue with a small black smudge on it, soft light.

p4-08.label: P4·08
p4-08.title: 얼굴이 긴 혼주님, 머리는 반대로 가세요
p4-08.loop_voice: 옆머리와 가르마, 두 가지가 더 남았어요. 나이 들어 보이지 않게 하는 방법이에요.

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated in a salon chair, low neat chignon, pale pink jeogori, soft light, no mirror visible, NOT a wedding hall.
scenes.m: An extremely slow push-in toward her chignon; soft light glints on the hair; she stays perfectly still.

scenes.img: Still life: two tail combs lying crossed in opposite directions on a salon counter beside hair pins, soft light.
Close back view of the same woman's head: one hand (natural nails, no rings) rests flat on the smooth crown of her low chignon.
scenes.m: The hand slowly smooths the crown flat once, then rests; one action only, five natural fingers.

p5-10.label: P5·08
p5-10.title: 혼주 한복 원단, 광택 고르는 법
p5-10.loop_voice: 그럼 노란 기가 도는 웜톤이라면요? 오히려 피해야 할 원단이 있어요.

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride in a hanbok shop, touching bolts of silk on a shelf, soft daylight, NOT a wedding hall.
scenes.m: Her hand slowly glides along the silk bolts; one action only; she never turns.

scenes.img: Still life: folded hanbok silks in pale pink and soft lavender stacked on a wooden table, soft daylight.
Close still life: a fold of lustrous cool pale pink myeongju silk catching the light like a soft reflector.
scenes.m: Light slowly travels across the silk, making a gentle sheen glide over it; nothing else moves.

scenes.img: Close back view of the same woman holding a lustrous pale pink silk swatch up near her shoulder, soft window light, NOT a wedding hall.
